newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Wet Seal cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Wet Seal cut.

text.p: -- Ladenburg Thalmann said analyst Chad Jacobs downgraded Wet Seal Inc to long-term buy from buy.
-- believes earnings estimate for the fourth quarter "could be in jeopardy if January does not show strong comp sales" for the women's apparel retailer.
-- believes fourth quarter comparisons "are running below analysts' expectations of roughly six percent and the company's internal plan."
-- said November and early December results "were especially weak, but the company has seen a turnaround in momentum and anticipates January will show continued improvement."
-- said if "appropriate acquisition (by company) does not present itself, the company will not be able to accelerate its new store opening plan beyond 30 locations per year until FY January 1999.
-- said that, with more difficult comparisons on the horizon, probability of significant comp-store gains becomes "increasingly problematic."
